about: Diagnostic scrubbing (appendix A 12): what is removed from any message, warning, fix or --verbose metadata before it is printed. Keys matching ct0, auth_token, cookie, authorization, csrf or bearer (any case) have their values replaced; a Bearer token and a key=value or key: value of those names inside text are replaced; a pbs.twimg.com URL loses its query string. source: code (previous errors.py). All values are synthetic.
